newsitem.title: UK: D. Hunter buys German air filter company.
newsitem.headline: D. Hunter buys German air filter company.

text.p: UK filtration and purification equipment company Domnick Hunter Plc said on Wednesday it is buying ZANDER Aufbereitungstechnik GmbH (ZANDER) for 16.5 million marks, or 6.1 million stg.
ZANDER makes compressed air filters and dryers, is based in Essen, Germany and was founded in 1977 by Bernd Zander, its chief executive and owner.
ZANDER had 1996 consolidated profit before tax of 1.6 million marks on sales of 34.9 million marks. Net assets at the year end were not less than 1.2 million marks.

The price will be paid with 13.5 million marks in cash and 3.0 million marks through the issue of 317,713 shares in Domnick Hunter. A possible further maximum cash payment of 2.0 marks may be made dependent upon the final level of ZANDER's audited net assets.
